newsitem.title: UK: UBS names new global fixed income head.
newsitem.headline: UBS names new global fixed income head.

text.p: Swiss banking giant Union Bank of Switzerland said on Thursday it had appointed John Costas as its global head of fixed income following the resignation of Richard Briance, who is leaving the firm this week.

Banking sources said Briance's departure was the result of differences in management strategy with Hans-Peter Bauer, the firm's London-based global head of fixed income and derivatives. Briance, who hired Costas in 1996, had been at UBS since 1991.
UBS names new global fixed income head
"We have built a very strong global fixed income team under Richard Briance, which has made it possible to effect a smooth and quick handover to John (Costas)," Bauer said in a statement.
Costas will be based in New York and will spend his time between UBS's main international offices in London, New York, Singapore and Tokyo.
UBS said 43-year-old Briance, who was not immediately available for comment, had done a "tremendous job for the bank over the past year" adding that he would be "greatly missed".

Banking sources said UBS had achieved record fixed income revenues in January, with every part of the fixed income business ahead of budget. They said other firms were likely to be keen to hire Briance, who is widely respected by his peers.
